To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the metastasis of KHT tumor to the ovaries and kidneys in female C3H/ HeJ mice is dependent on the presence of established lung colonies.
the metastatic KHT tumor cells in female mice grow in the ovaries and kidneys and are refractory to radiation treatment because of a large fraction of hypoxic cells.
ovarian metastases are radiation-resistant and that ovarian and renal tumors grow with a doubling time similar to the parent KHT lung tumors.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a model of tumor cell dissemination and metastasis to the ovary and kidney and the response of metastatic tumors to irradiation.
the characterization of a model system in which metastatic disease is induced in a defined anatomical site by thoracic irradiation of mice bearing established intravascular tumors.
the study of the factors influencing the development of metastases in the ovary and kidney of C3H/ HeJ mice and their response to radiation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the growth of metastatic tumor cells is a function of the number of viable tumor cells in the primary tumor, the rate at which the cells are released into the circulation and the rate at which they are cleared from the circulation by the reticuloendothelial system.
the KHT tumor cell line is capable of metastasizing to the ovary and kidney in female and male C3H mice, respectively, and that this metastatic process can be influenced by radiation treatment.

the growth rate of KHT metastases is not influenced by the anatomical site of metastasis, but that the radiation response of these tumors is dependent on the anatomical site and the presence of oxygen in the tumors.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the metastases of KHT sarcoma to ovary and kidneys is a consequence of the establishment of a primary tumor in the lungs and is a function of the time between tumor cell inoculation and local radiation of the thorax.
the KHT cell line is a good model for the study and characterization of tumor metastasis and the response of these tumors to radiation therapy.
the metastasis of KHT cells from lung to ovaries and kidneys was a function of the time interval between intravenous cell inoculation and irradiation of lung colonies.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the metastatic potential and the response to radiation therapy of a given tumor may depend on the anatomical site to which the tumor has metastasized.
metastases to ovaries and kidneys can arise from established lung colonies.
ovarian metastases from lung tumors are refractory to radiation treatment due to a large component of hypoxic cells.
